name: Forrester Family Nursing and Teaching Practical Placement Bursary
summary: A placement bursary for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander QUT students on a work integrated learning placement.
who: Australian or NZ citizen or Australian permanent resident.
Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander, confirmed by the Oodgeroo Unit or Carumba Institute.
Confirmed in a work integrated learning placement when awarded.
how: Apply with the application form, with your transcript, a response to the selection criteria and proof of descent.
catches: The terms found are the 2025 terms. Check the current round.
Not available if you already get a similar placement bursary.

source.label: QUT: Forrester Family Practical Placement Bursary

evidence.quote: is a bursary valued at either $250, $500 or $750, offered to continuing domestic students.

evidence.claim: Must be on a WIL placement
evidence.quote: Must be confirmed in a work integrated learning (WIL) placement at time of being awarded the Bursary.
